integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Realistic cinematic live-action photography in natural daylight with a shallow-to-moderate depth of field. Extreme close-up portrait fully matching the referenced frame: a young East Asian woman with a short black layered bob, wispy strands falling across her forehead and cheek, cool almond eyes with soft grey-blue contact lenses, glossy muted-rose lips held slightly parted, faint blush across the cheekbones, an ornate gold-and-red earring, long black manicured nails, a red satin ribbon choker at the throat, and a deep crimson feathered garment filling the lower frame, against a pale wall crossed by thin horizontal grey stripes. She holds one hand beside her cheek with fingertips grazing her jawline and looks directly forward with a calm, emotionally detached expression. A nearly imperceptible breath lifts one loose strand, the satin ribbon and feather barbs shift a few millimetres, and the specular highlight on her lips and eyes travels slightly as her head turns a fraction toward her left. Static Shot at slow speed.

[Shot 2] At 00:00.700, the camera cuts to a full-body long shot on a sunlit park path. An open, bright sky fills the upper third of the frame above a low pale concrete wall running along the left side of the walkway; against the base of that wall sit one small crumpled plastic bag and one folded umbrella. The path recedes behind her, and generous casual negative space of open sky and empty pavement surrounds the figure on both sides. The same woman, 175 cm tall with long slim legs, now wears a heather-grey backless knit sweater falling to her hips, sleeveless with the sides cut away and the neckline slipped off one shoulder to bare the shoulder blade and the side of her torso, paired with black over-knee socks. She walks slowly and directly toward the camera, her upper body rotating slightly with each advance so the bare shoulder, the curve of her waist and the length of her legs turn alternately toward the lens. Her right hand presses the slipped neckline flat against her chest to hold it against the wind, while her left hand hangs at her side carrying a clear glass bottle of lemonade beaded all over with condensation, the droplets catching the daylight as the bottle swings gently with each step; loose hair shifts at her temples and the sweater hem ripples against her hips with the motion. Tracking Shot dollying backward at slow speed to hold her complete height inside the frame while she closes the distance. She keeps a cool, aloof expression, lips slightly parted, her gaze passing over and beyond the lens instead of meeting it. She ends closer, still mid-stride, the bottle lowered and swinging, the grey neckline still held in place, while the bright open sky, the plastic bag and the folded umbrella behind her remain unchanged.
